Go Pantheon. $ 199.97 In stock Pantheon Overdrive quantity Add to cart SKU: WMP-PBS-PED Category: Distortion / Overdrive Tag: overdrive warning Cancer and Reproductive Harm www.p65warnings.ca.gov More of You The reason the original BB circuit is so legendary, and why so many cool stompboxes have been based on it, has to do with the way it introduces harmonics and grit into the tone you’ve already worked so hard to get, without altering it’s natural sound or drowning the player’s touch in needless extra compression or grit. The Pantheon takes faithful inspiration from this circuit, but keeps the sound entirely yours. Always the Right Fit The Pantheon gives you enough tonal tweaking options to enhance the rest of your rig without muddying things up. The Baxandall-style active bass control is neutral at noon but boasts an extremely powerful sweep as you move through the range. And in addition to the standard tone control, you’ll also find a presence control for adding just the right amount of top-end chime to fit your different guitars and output devices… live, in the studio, or as part of a larger chain. Not just another Clone This type of overdrive circuit is used in some very different ways by different players…. The native sound has passed the test of time, but Brian Wampler has added enough easily accessible gain control to transport you through the decades at the flick of a switch. The 3-way Gain Level switch toggles between the most useful and usable Drive degrees, and the 3-position Overdrive Voice switch selects between hard and soft clipping or a mix of both! That’s every shade of dirt you’ll ever need. Built for Forever Brian Wampler’s attention to detail and commitment to bringing you the best-sounding & most usable Effects Boxes on the market is nothing new. sources.excerpt: Wampler Pedals Pantheon Overdrive | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Overdrive / Wampler Pedals Pantheon Overdrive Pantheon Overdrive The Wampler Pantheon is a versatile overdrive pedal inspired by British breakup, offering a wide range of tones from sweet push to high-gain grind. It features independent channels for versatile sounds, with controls for bass, treble, and presence, and is a favorite for its ability to work with various guitar styles. Its dynamic response and ability to stack with other pedals make it a standout option for guitarists seeking a versatile overdrive experience, and has been compared to the Marshall BluesBreaker pedal for its core sound. What Wampler Pedals say about the Pantheon Overdrive The Wampler Pantheon gives you all the unmistakably British break up and tonal nuance found in the best of these revered circuits…. Go Pantheon. www.wamplerpedals.com What guitarists say... Guitarists praised the Wampler Pantheon's versatility and ability to cover a wide range of overdrive sounds, from clean boost to high-gain distortion. Users found the pedal worked well with various guitars and amplifiers, with many highlighting its dynamic response and tonal flexibility. Reviewers were impressed by its ability to cut through a mix and its suitability for both single-coil and humbucker pickups. Several reviewers stated that the Pantheon is their favorite overdrive pedal and that it has earned a permanent spot on their pedalboards.
